scope: Bilingual service revision; translation and production deployment authorized by Alex on 2026-11-11
policy: List confirmed playable destinations, not every advertising company. Export requirements and access depend on the account and placement. Platform links in the infographic point to official references.

corrections.name: ironSource Ads
corrections.finding: Direct demand ended on 2026-04-30. ironSource Exchange programmatic demand and LevelPlay mediation are separate and remain supported. Do not list legacy ironSource Ads as an active direct campaign destination.

corrections.name: AdColony
corrections.finding: Affle announced the acquisition of selected technology assets and the trademark on 2026-06-15; DT described the sale the following day. AdColony is not an alias of DT Exchange. New AdColony playable requirements were not independently confirmed, so it is explained in a note rather than advertised as a verified build target.

corrections.name: Liftoff
corrections.finding: Official Liftoff playable documentation remains hosted under support.vungle.com. Use Liftoff with Vungle as a recognizable secondary label, not duplicate targets.

corrections.name: TikTok Ad Network
corrections.finding: The current official documentation names TikTok Ad Network, formerly TikTok Pangle. TikTok in-app and ad-network placements have separate references.
